_doc: [ui2] Pure cosmetics now (the Locker): owning a part unlocks it for every robot, nothing is used up, and parts change no stats; only the Settler set (three Settler parts) keeps the small set_bonus perk. haggle-source parts are simply bought (cubes + parts); craft-source parts cost parts + the old robot part item's value (RobotBuilder.craft_parts). [drones] Robot Builder parts. Five slots per robot; 'stock' (no entry) keeps the Mk tier's own look and stats. mods are multipliers on generic stats: speed, load (hopper capacity / fork carry / water tank), work (scoop / plant / spray / refill rate), quality (cube efficiency), reach (spray radius), scan (chance to spot salvage while working). Every non-cosmetic part has at least one upside and one downside (gentle: specialised, not strictly better). source: craft (parts + one stored robot part of a type, optional cubes), haggle (Haggle's rotating builder stall: cubes + parts), request (unlocked by the Requests board after `requests` finished requests, events.json requests.track), research (unlock node, then craft), drop (rare finds), set (parts + a Vintage-or-better robot part). [money] Bolts and Settler Fragments are Parts now (x5, x25). roles: which crews a tool fits (multibots take any tool).

salvage._doc: Working robots spot salvage now and then: chance per second = base * scan. A find is a stored part (mostly Rusty/Worn); 1 in fragment_one_in is a Settler Fragment.

haggle._doc: Haggle's builder stall: `offers` haggle-source parts, reshuffled every `rotate_s` seconds of play.
